title: Saul on the road to Damascus blinded by an orb
summary: Chris Bledsoe tells of Saul on the road to Damascus blinded by an orb, about 1st century at Road to Damascus, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.
plain: Chris Bledsoe, a man who says he has seen many strange lights himself, gives his reading of a Bible story from the Book of Acts, where a man named Saul is struck blind by a light on the road to Damascus. Bledsoe says simply that it was an orb, a glowing ball of light, which would link that ancient religious moment to the lights people report today.
